schedules.title: CVPen daily growth opportunities
schedules.prompt: Prepare a practical daily growth brief for CVPen, an ATS-focused CV improvement service in Egypt. Include 3 offer/content experiments, one low-cost acquisition channel, a draft CTA, and measurable KPIs. Do not invent demand or conversion data. Separate hypotheses from verified facts.

schedules.title: QudSystem social content draft
schedules.prompt: Create one useful Arabic Egyptian social post for QudSystem about custom software, AI automation, websites, dashboards, or business process improvement. Avoid hype and fear. Include a clear business problem, concrete solution, proof requirements, CTA, and 3 hashtags. Draft only; do not publish.

schedules.title: Short-form video concept and script
schedules.prompt: Create one 30-45 second vertical video concept for QudSystem or CVPen. Deliver hook, storyboard, Egyptian Arabic voiceover, on-screen text, B-roll/editing notes, English subtitle translation, and CTA. Keep production possible with a phone and free tools. Do not claim a video was rendered.

schedules.title: Target customer segments and outreach drafts
schedules.prompt: Identify best-fit customer segments for QudSystem web/software/AI automation services and CVPen in Egypt. Produce an ICP, qualification questions, ethical public-source research plan, and personalized outreach templates. Never fabricate named leads, contact details, or claim anyone was contacted.

schedules.title: QudSystem SEO improvement plan
schedules.prompt: Create a prioritized SEO plan for a small Egyptian software and AI company targeting Egypt and English-speaking international customers. Include service-page structure, search-intent clusters, technical SEO checks, internal linking, and a 4-week content roadmap. Flag anything requiring live website inspection.

schedules.title: Daily operations review and error-prevention plan
schedules.prompt: Produce a daily operational review framework for QudSystem's active workstreams. Prioritize identifying blockers, quality risks, missed handoffs, duplicated effort, and errors that should be fixed today. Clearly distinguish observed evidence from unknowns: this worker may not have access to live execution logs or external app statuses, so never claim a real task was completed or failed unless evidence is supplied. Deliver a same-day action queue with severity, owner role, validation test, and rollback note.

schedules.title: Three-day process optimization review
schedules.prompt: Run a structured optimization review for QudSystem's service delivery and internal agent workflows. Evaluate time/cost/quality trade-offs, failure modes, repeated rework, prompt clarity, automation opportunities, and customer experience. Propose the smallest high-impact improvements, expected measurable outcomes, risks, and an experiment plan. Do not invent operating metrics; mark missing measurements and propose how to collect them.

schedules.title: Weekly deep strategic reasoning and portfolio review
schedules.prompt: Conduct a deep weekly strategy review for QudSystem across CVPen, custom software and AI automation services, mini-apps, QudSchool/Qudemy, and Vision Guard Systems. Prioritize revenue potential, customer segment precision, competitor positioning, differentiation, delivery economics, brand trust, and execution capacity. For CVPen, build a realistic path toward EGP 100,000-200,000 monthly revenue using explicit price x volume x conversion assumptions, funnel math, channel experiments, and capacity constraints; do not promise results or fabricate competitor intelligence. Include long-horizon strategic options, short-horizon next-week actions, downside scenarios, and a decision log of assumptions to validate.

schedules.title: Vision Guard Systems trust-led customer education
schedules.prompt: Create one Egyptian Arabic educational post for Vision Guard Systems about CCTV, access control, installation quality, maintenance, camera placement, or choosing a security solution. Use reassurance and clarity, not fear. Include a useful tip, a transparent service CTA, and what proof (real installation photo, warranty terms, technician credentials) should be added before publication. Draft only.

schedules.title: QudSchool daily learning idea
schedules.prompt: Create a short Egyptian Arabic post or parent-facing learning idea for QudSchool, an engaging coding/AI/design learning experience for children. Include age-appropriate learning outcome, simple activity, parent benefit, and a truthful CTA. Do not invent active enrollment, curriculum completion, student outcomes, or platform capabilities.

schedules.title: QudCopy product and customer value review
schedules.prompt: Review QudCopy as a product that helps turn visual references into front-end implementation workflows. Identify one high-value customer segment, 3 workflow improvements, measurable acceptance criteria, risks, and a low-cost experiment. Distinguish product facts from assumptions; do not claim current user analytics are available.

schedules.title: Qudemy curriculum and partnership strategy
schedules.prompt: Develop a practical weekly curriculum and partnership strategy for Qudemy/QudAcademy in Egypt under a near-zero operating budget. Prioritize employable AI, software, cybersecurity, and digital skills; define one free cohort-to-paid-advanced pathway, trainer QA, learner projects, transparent certificate wording, and partner value. No invented partnerships or student outcomes.

schedules.title: QudSystem engineering and reliability backlog
schedules.prompt: Create a prioritized engineering quality review for QudSystem's products and service delivery. Cover security basics, dependency risk, monitoring, backups, accessibility, performance, regression tests, and deployment safety. Provide acceptance criteria and rollback notes. Do not claim to have inspected repositories or deployed systems unless files/logs are supplied.

schedules.title: QudSystem service FAQ and objection handling
schedules.prompt: Create one useful customer FAQ/objection response for QudSystem services. Explain scope, process, required customer inputs, delivery expectations, revision boundaries, and what is not guaranteed. Use Egyptian Arabic. Avoid fabricated prices, timelines, warranty claims, or portfolio proof; flag details that need business-owner approval.

schedules.title: QudSystem portfolio KPI and revenue review
schedules.prompt: Create a measurement plan for QudSystem services with priority on CVPen revenue and fulfillment. Define daily metrics for qualified inquiries, paid orders, average order value, conversion, delivery time, revision rate, refunds, contribution margin, and acquisition cost. No actual results are available unless supplied; present formulas and data collection requirements, not invented numbers.

schedules.title: Weekly QudSystem privacy, payment, and reliability review
schedules.prompt: Review the design risks for a multi-service AI business: customer data minimization, tenant isolation, retention, audit logging, model provider data handling, webhook verification, duplicate payment callbacks, secrets management, backup/restore, and incident response. Provide specific controls and test cases. This is a design review, not a compliance certification.
